title: Droplet profile
description: profiles/<name>.yaml in the infra repo: the recipe for a droplet the tool creates. The region is not part of the profile: it follows the droplet's env (account.yaml digitalocean.regions); the VPC is the region's default.

name.description: Must equal the file name without .yaml.

image.description: DigitalOcean image slug, pinned (bumped by pull request), e.g. ubuntu-26-04-x64.

user_data.description: cloud-init file in profiles/ (a plain file name, must start with #cloud-config).
